title: Help NMKR to continue operations & develop NFT Infrastructure

ms.promise:
Rationale: The whole idea of this proposal is to help NMKR generate revenue while going through the bear market and keeping the "details of implementation" relatively lean so that, as a startup, we can keep operating without being bound to a strict plan that would hinder any innovation.
Because of this, we set 3 key milestones:
・Enhancement of NMKR Roadmap
・Open Sourcing NMKR Studio
・Onboarding more businesses to Cardano

Now, unfortunately, 3 aren't enough for this milestone-based funding model, so we're stretching them to 6...
And since apparently my idea of a simple technical plan is too little planning for the reviewer, we decided to skip the plan altogether because honestly it's not really necessary for the actual deployment of anything we're planning anyways and we'll just literally split up the 3 milestones into 6.

So, let's begin.
Milestone Nr. 1 Output (taken from Milestone 1 "Enhancement of NMKR Roadmap" from the IdeaScale submission):
・CIP 68 Integration: CIP68 is integrated and available to everyone in NMKR Studio

The remaining parts two parts of this enhancement are:
・Integration of additional Storage Solutions
・Plugin Support

which will both be addressed in Milesto
ms.criteria:
・User can register in NMKR Studio & mint an NFT using CIP68

Note: The enhancement of current roadmap is already outlined specifically in Ideascale. It's:
・Implement CIP-68
・Integrate more decentralized storage solutions
・Add plugin support

These are the three things that will be part of the roadmap (and in this and the next milestone)
In this specific milestone the competition of the first item of the roadmap is the goal.

・Initiate partnerships with businesses interested in NFTs.

In this Milestone, we'll be focusing on:

ms.report:
We are pleased to submit the proof of achievement for this milestone.
The objective of this milestone is to develop a business outreach program designed to initiate new partnerships with businesses. While NMKR already provides support to onboarded businesses - often leading to new partnerships through word-of-mouth referrals - this milestone emphasizes a proactive approach. Specifically, we focused on:
・Developing a business outreach program to actively reach out to new partners, projects, and businesses.

To achieve this, we conducted thorough research to determine what an effective business outreach program should entail. Based on our findings, we formulated a detailed plan outlining how we will structure and launch the program, as detailed below.
This plan articulates the business outreach strategy, explaining the chosen approach and the rationale behind our decisions.
The comprehensive plan is documented as a file, available here: Outreach and business plan NMKR_ final
As per your revision, we have specified in the document in which milestone we will deliver information on the progress on the objectives of item 2, and in which milestones we will deliver the deliverables of item 6. We also appreciate your feedback, that the budget in the plan (section 8) was in USD while the project funding is in ADA. For the sake of consistency, we have of course adjusted the plan.
